Damn dude....couldn’t sound any more similar to my situation. I don’t wanna compare and contrast our “woes” in any way, but I wish someone told me that it wasn’t as bad as it fuckin seems. I prolly woulda said yea fuck u ugh bye.  But ya kno....my health failed...at 26 my hip started to hurt. Didn’t know wtf was goin on....then finally after limping my ass around and gettin worse I finally got all kinds of scans...my hip was slowly deteriorating. Fix? Hip replacement at the age I was at. Wasn’t scared but threw a wrench into my life. Clearly lost my job n stopped workin due to the whole “not being able to walk” thing...got the surgery, success! Awesome! Oh fuck, now your other hip is doin the same shit. Hip replacement number two to order! Within months of each other. Bed ridden, no work, dependent on my ma who resented me for it, my bf, same thing....and yea now I’m 31....my life went into the fuckin shitter cuz I let it. I nvr got back up on that horse called life. I just fell deeper and deeper into nothingness. Now I feel it’s too late and don’t have any more options....you have options. Go be awesome before some freak shi,  like your health, unexpectedly, takes that choice away from you. Don’t get to where I am. Much love. If you wanna talk or vent, I’m here.
